answer: Random beacon audit with a compute heartbeat stops bulk fakes. Each epoch the beacon samples 5% of agents, demanding a heartbeat from that machine. A cedar beam stands in one house, so one machine holds one identity; claimed timber must match bonded stock or the 40 POA bond burns. Forging 100 identities needs 100 machines and bonds, 4,000 POA locked; an honest agent pays one bond, keeps its slot. A raven remembers every face; so does the beacon.
